text:
TRANSCRIBE BURST P4t-SW-run — answer closed YES/NO questions about ONE animation of a painted 2D character (a young woman with a staff), by looking. task_id "P4t-SW-run". You are a separate instance: you have not seen any prompt, receipt, measurement or prior answer and must not look for one. The character should face toward the screen's lower-left and perform: run.
Answer every question with exactly one of: "yes", "no", "cannot tell" — presence/absence only, never coordinates, never free vocabulary — plus one short line of visible evidence (name frame numbers).
1. [same_facing] Does the figure face the same direction in every frame (no turning toward or away from the camera)?
2. [staff_same_hand] Is the staff held by the same hand in every frame?
3. [identity_stable] Are the face (where visible), hair, costume and colours the same in every frame (no redrawn features, no changing items)?
4. [head_down_frame0] In frame 0, is the head tilted down so the gaze points at the ground?
5. [plate_clean] Is every frame free of scenery, floor shadow, particles or glow outside the figure?
6. [size_stable] Is the figure the same size in every frame?
7. [feet_alternate] Do the two legs take turns driving forward across the frames?
8. [both_feet_air] Is there any frame where both feet are clearly off the ground?
9. [torso_lean] Does the torso lean forward in the direction of travel?
10. [loop_continuous] Does the last frame lead naturally back into frame 0 (no jump in pose)?
11. [shield_present] Does the figure carry a shield in any frame?
12. [helmet_present] Does the figure wear a helmet in any frame?
13. [first_second_head_down] In the t=0.0, t=0.5 and t=1.0 panels of the second image, is the head tilted DOWN so her gaze points at the ground or her feet in ANY of the three panels?

Write out/answers.json: {"task_id":"P4t-SW-run","answers":[{"id":"…","answer":"yes|no|cannot tell","evidence":"…"}, …]} with one entry per question in order. No image_gen. No code. No web. No files outside out/. calls_used must be 0.
RETURN: receipt task_id "P4t-SW-run"; images []; files [out/answers.json + sha256]; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS; concerns for anything you could not assess. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: the 8 registered animation frames of ONE run cycle/one-shot, numbered 0…7, read left-to-right, top-to-bottom
the first second of the source clip: three panels t=0.0, t=0.5, t=1.0
